people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
translations.bsb: So since you saw no form of any kind on the day the LORD spoke to you out of the fire at Horeb, be careful
translations.kjv: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
translations.asv: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of form on the day that Jehovah spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire.
